data.speakerBio: 沈健,国家杰青( B 类, 2007 )、国家特聘专家( 2009 )、美国物理学会会士( Fellow , 2011 ),复旦大学"浩清"讲席教授 ( 2009 ),曾任复旦大学物理系主任( 2010-2020 ),现任复旦大学应用表面物理全国重点实验室主任、微纳电子器件与量子计算机研究院院长、微纳加工公共实验室主任、中国物理学会磁学专委会主任。曾获德国马普学会 Otto-Hahn 奖章、美国能源部杰出青年科学家奖、美国总统青年科技奖( PECASE )。长期从事低维磁性、自旋电子学及其在存储与智能计算中的应用,在包括 APS 、 MRS 、 AVS 、 MMM 、 Intermag 等重大国际会议上做邀请报告 140 余次(含大会报告 10 次)。
data.abstract: 当今世界,以人工智能( AI )为核心的神经网络模型(如 ChatGPT )的快速发展,大大改变了人们的生活和思维方式。目前的神经网络模型是基于存算分离的冯诺依曼计算架构,尽管已经取得了巨大成功,但内存和处理器之间频繁的数据传输产生的焦耳热等能耗问题日益显著。尤其对于需处理海量数据的智能计算,能耗的问题尤为突出,致使算力的持续提升面临巨大挑战。为了突破当前智能计算的能耗瓶颈,我们尝试构建基于物理体系演化过程的更高能效的新型计算架构和范式。我们利用自旋体系在储备池计算、联想记忆、小样本训练、概率计算等方面做出了很有成效的探索,为物理体系在未来智能计算中的应用奠定了重要基础。

data.speakerBio: 王魁东，西安交通大学电子科学与工程学院特聘研究员/副教授，博士生导师。先后于上海交通大学激光等离子体教育部重点实验室、法国斯特拉斯堡大学获得博士学位并做博士后研究。西安交通大学“青年拔尖人才支持计划”。主要从事人工微结构与半导体薄膜强耦合下的超快非线性光学效应以及复合体系超快动力学过程的研究。研究工作以第一作者或通讯作者发表于Nat. Commun., Nano Lett., ACS Photon., Phys. Rev. B及Appl. Phys. Lett.等国际著名期刊；在本领域国际国内会议上作邀请报告、口头报告十余次；主持/参与国内国际项目9项，其中主持国家自然科学基金1项及西安交大青年拔尖人才项目1项，作为核心成员曾参与欧盟项目2项（ERC和QuantERA）、法国国家科研署项目1项（ANR）；担任Ultrafast Science期刊青年编委。
data.abstract: 光与物质的强耦合为理解光与物质相互作用及探寻物质新特性提供了有效的手段。当光学腔的模式与物质的激子模式发生强耦合时，两者耦合所产生的极化激元可改变物质本身的物理、化学等特性。近些年来，研究发现，此种准粒子的产生也会极大地增强材料体系原本较弱的非线性光学特性，如二次谐波与三次谐波的产生与增强。在此基础上，本报告总结了本课题组近些年利用强耦合（光与物质强耦合，全光强耦合）增强超快三阶非线性光学系数、实现对光场强度与偏振态的飞秒级调控、研究强耦合体系超快动力学中的选择定则及低阈值极化激元激射等方面的进展，并探讨后续可能的研究方向。

data.speakerBio: 张刚,现任北京理工大学长三角研究院(嘉兴)战略科学家,北京理工大学教授、博导,澳大利亚卧龙岗大学荣誉教授。专业集中在量子材料、高性能计算和光热电可再生能源材料与管理理论、技术和应用领域,共发表论文 400 余篇, 总引用 3 万余次, H 因子 93 。主持新加坡、中国国家级、省部级项目数十项,总经费超过 2 亿元。浙江省"顶尖人才计划",当选美国物理学会会士、英国物理学会会士,入选"斯坦福大学全球顶尖科学家终身影响力榜单",科睿唯安"全球高被引科学家"名单。为中国微米纳米技术学会理事,微纳米系统热管理分会理事长。
data.abstract: 随着微纳电子器件、高功率集成系统、新能源技术和航空航天等领域的快速发展,先进热管理材料成为制约系统性能、可靠性与能效的关键瓶颈。人工智能科学的发展和计算机运算能力的不断提高,为复杂材料体系的研究提供了新的手段,材料的"数智"设计也应运而生,并迅速得到发展。

data.speakerBio: 姚力丁,普渡大学韦恩堡分校助理教授。2022年于美国威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校取得博士学位,后于俄亥俄州立大学任博士后。姚力丁主要从事调和分析方面的研究,以及调和分析在微分几何、多复变函数以及函数空间方向上的应用。目前在Amer. Jour. of Math, Trans. of AMS, J. Funct. Anal, J. Anal. Math.等国际数学期刊上共发表论文13篇
data.abstract: In this talk we will introduce certain weak compactness conditions for bounded linear maps, called strictly and finitely strictly singular. We give a classification of all non-compact embedding between Besov spaces, both on bounded domains and on $\Bbb R^n$, that are finitely strictly singular or strictly singular. As a direct application, we give a simple proof that the Sobolev-Lorentz embedding $W_0^{1,p}(\Omega)\to L^{p^*,q}(\Omega)$ for $\Omega\subset\Bbb R^n$, $p^*=\frac{np}{n-p}$, $p<q\le\infty$ is finitely strictly singular, which simplifies the previous work by Lang-Mihula. This is a joint work with Chian Yeong Chuah and Jan Lang.

data.speakerBio: 王子鹏研究员于2015年获得英国剑桥大学数学博士学位,攻读博士期间,自2012年起同时在美国普林斯顿大学进行博士课题研究,师从国际调和分析数学家EliasM.Stein。王子鹏研究员的主要研究领域为调和分析,当前的研究兴趣主要集中在乘积空间上的分数次积分(fractionalintegrals)和傅立叶积分(Fourierintegrals),并已取得一系列研究成果,特别是基于锥分割(ConeDecomposition)这个新方法,证明了两个关于乘积空间上分数积分的猜想,即乘积空间上的Stein-Weiss不等式及乘积空间上的Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev不等式。

张春健,复旦大学青年研究员、博士生导师,2020年博士毕业于中国科学院上海应用物理研究所,2020-2024年在纽约州立大学石溪分校从事博士后研究,2024年任职于复旦大学现代物理研究所/核科学与技术系。入选国家优秀青年科学基金(海外)、上海市白玉兰海外青年人才和浦江人才,主持国家重点研发计划青年科学家项目,获美国 RHIC&AGS Merit Award 。主要从事高能重离子碰撞物理,近年来围绕跨能量尺度原子核结构、夸克胶子等离子体及强相互作用物质性质开展实验研究。发表学术论文 45 篇,其中包括 Nature、ROPP 及4篇 PRL 论文。相关成果被 Nature 以 News&Views、News、Podcast 专栏亮点报道。
data.abstract: 原子核的形变、中子皮及集团结构等特征,是原子核作为有限量子多体系统的重要体现,也是核物理研究的重要前沿问题。近年来,随着高能重离子碰撞实验数据的不断积累以及流体动力学模型的发展,人们可以通过相对论重离子碰撞实现对原子核结构的瞬时成像。在极端相对论能量下,碰撞原子核的结构信息被编码于碰撞的初始条件中,并通过夸克-胶子等离子体的流体演化映射到末态粒子的动量分布上。本报告将介绍利用高能重离子碰撞成像原子核结构的基本思想与方法框架,并展示在不同碰撞体系中的实验进展,包括铀-238形变的测量、同质异位素钌-96和锆-96的形变及中子皮研究、氧-16集团结构的探索。最后将展望这一方法作为连接 MeV 至 TeV 能标核物理研究的重要新工具的应用前景。

data.speakerBio: 兰晶岗博士,特聘教授。本科毕业于华东理工大学,硕士毕业于马德里自治大学,博士毕业于苏黎世大学,师从 J ü rg Hutter 教授。博士毕业后,先后在瑞士洛桑联邦理工学院和纽约大学从事博士后研究。 2024 年加入深圳理工大学。主要从事理论与计算化学、第一性原理分子动力学、机器学习势能面以及复杂水相、界面与溶剂化电子体系的多尺度模拟研究。迄今为止,以第一 / 通讯作者发表论文约 30 余篇,包括 Nature Communications 、 PNAS 、 JACS 、 Angew. data.abstract: 凝聚态水系在材料科学、电化学和纳米技术中发挥着至关重要的作用,许多反应发生在水相系统,如固液界面,或涉及离子的参与。理解这些过程对电化学和电解质的研究具有重要启示。在本次报告中,我将首先讨论水 - 金属界面的高效模拟方法及其在一氧化碳振动光谱和还原反应中的应用,并探讨核量子效应对金属 - 水界面的影响。在第二部分,我将介绍如何利用高精度电子结构理论(如 MP2 和杂化泛函)、分子动力学和机器学习对水合电子进行高效且准确的模拟,并成功解释其动力学过程、振动光谱以及温度响应的吸收光谱等性质。

data.speakerBio: 高申春,哲学博士,吉林大学哲学社会学院心理学教授、博士生导师,哈佛 -燕京学社2003-2004年度访问学者。曾任中国心理学会理事、理论心理与心理学史专业委员会主任,现任理论心理与心理学史专业委员会委员、中国社会心理学会常务理事、吉林省心理学会监事长、吉林省哲学会常务理事。研究领域涉及理论心理学、西方心理学史、现象学哲学等。出版个人专著3部、参编著作6部、译著12部,发表论文90余篇,主持或完成国家社科基金、教育部人文社科基金、教育部人文社会科学重点基地研究项目及其他项目10余项。 5月9日吉林大学高申春教授学术
data.abstract: 对 "科学"观念的深入分析表明,它原来是文艺复兴以来自然科学连续且加速的发展逐步我们现代人世界观的产物。正是在这个背景中,心理学作为科学的观念强势兴起,不仅获得相对独立性融入那个时代的思想史趋势,并构成其历史动力学过程中最具主导性的思想史力量之一。布伦塔诺通过对心理学与科学之间奠基关系的系统分析揭示,只有奠定在心理学的基础之上,科学才是可能的;追求实现这种能够为科学奠基的心理学,就是布伦塔诺的心理学理想,并通过意向性概念蕴含了现象学心理学的方向和道路。

data.speakerBio: 2005年在山东大学获得本科学位。2008-2012年,作为联合培养博士研究生在美国威斯康星大学从事ATLAS实验研究。2012年在山东大学获得理学博士学位。2012-2017年,在美国纽约州立大学石溪分校从事博士后研究工作。2017年9月到山东大学工作。主要研究内容以及成果:在Higgs粒子发现时期(2011-2012年)作为Higgs到双W道的主要分析者之一;是Higgs到双缪子的创始者之一,曾担任该分析团队的负责人;开展了顶夸克偶素的研究。
data.abstract: This talk will review the recent H → μμ and toponium results from the ATLAS experiment at the Large Hadron Collider. For H → μμ search, an excess of events over the background is observed with a significance of 3.4σ. This result provides evidence for the H → μμ decay with ATLAS data and offers a direct probe of the Higgs-boson Yukawa coupling to second-generation fermions. For toponium search, an excess of events is observed over the baseline perturbative QCD prediction with an observed significance of 8σ. This excess is consistent with the formation of color-singlet, S-wave, quasi-bound t¯t states as predicted by non-relativistic QCD.

data.speakerBio: 梁炜杰,华东师范大学物理学院在读博士,主要从事周期驱动冷原子系统中的动力学及多体相理论研究,近年来以第一作者身份发表 PRL 一篇、第二作者身份发表 PRA 一篇。
data.abstract: 在凝聚态物理中,研究人员通过将两层原子级薄膜堆叠并旋转特定角度得到 Moir é材料,并从中诱发出超导、关联绝缘态等奇特现象。然而,这种物理堆叠对工艺精度要求极高,且制备后参数便难以动态调节。与此同时,时间晶体作为一种可抵御热化的周期振荡多体相,是提升量子精密测量精度的理想候选体系。我们研究发现,通过操控原子在不同时间尺度下的多重周期运动,可以在时间维度诱导出各种 Moir é结构。随着系统演化,这种时域结构会进一步在空间维度显现,从而摆脱了物理扭转或机械堆叠的束缚。系统在进入 Moir é时间晶体相后,会展现出抗热化特性。这为在复杂环境下保持量子相干性提供了新的理论支撑,也为开发高精度、高鲁棒性的量子精密测量装置提供了新平台。

data.speakerBio: 任赞,2013年至2017年就读于北京航空航天大学物理科学与核能工程学院,获学士学位;2017年至2023年就读于清华大学高能物理研究中心并取得博士学位。自2023年8月起,在中国科学院大学物理学院从事博士后研究,并获得特别研究助理资助。 目前担任欧洲核子研究中心LHCb合作组底强子与夸克偶素工作组副召集人。主要从事对撞机实验上的强子谱学研究,包括B强子物理和奇特强子态的研究等。
data.abstract: LHCb是大型强子对撞机上专为重味物理和CP破坏研究而设计的前向谱仪实验,其优异的顶点探测和粒子鉴别能力为研究包含重夸克(粲、底夸克)的强子衰变提供了独特优势,使其成为探索强子结构、寻找新强子态的关键实验平台。本报告主要回顾报告人在强子谱学方面开展的有关研究:在奇特强子态研究方面,通过B强子到包含粲偶素或开粲强子的多体衰变,对四夸克态、五夸克态等超出传统夸克模型的奇特强子态进行了寻找与性质研究;在传统强子谱方面,开展了包括B强子的纯重子衰变、Bc介子新衰变模式的寻找和粲偶素产生截面的测量。这些工作为理解量子色动力学(QCD)在非微扰能区的性质,重味强子与奇特强子的产生与衰变机制提供了实验输入。

data.speakerBio: 李蓬勃,西安交大物理学院教授,副院长,国家级青年人才,陕西省杰青,西安交大青年拔尖人才 A 类。长期从事量子光学与量子信息中的基础物理问题研究,聚焦于混合量子系统的相互作用机制与调控理论。以第一或通讯作者在 Phys. Rev. 系列上发表学术论文 60 余篇(包括 7 篇 PRL )。编著教材《量子力学原理与应用》。主持国家自然科学基金项目 6 项,研究成果获陕西省科学技术奖一等奖。担任《 Physical Review Research 》编委,中国光学学会光量子科学与技术专业委员会委员,中国物理学会量子光学专业委员会青年委员,陕西省物理学会理事。
data.abstract: 不同量子系统之间的相干相互作用是量子物理和量子技术领域的一个基本科学问题。混合量子系统结合了多种完全不同的物理系统,可以实现单个组件无法提供的新功能,是实现高品质量子器件的重要系统。报告将首先简要介绍混合量子系统的研究背景,然后介绍我们课题组近两年在混合量子系统研究方面的主要工作,特别是在基于纳米机械体系的混合量子系统及其量子传感应用方面取得的最新进展。

data.speakerBio: 史永堂,南开大学教授、博导,主要研究领域是图论与组合优化,获国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金项目等资助;先后获评霍英东基金会青年科学奖二等奖、中国工业与应用数学学会应用数学青年科技奖、中国运筹学会青年科技奖等。
data.abstract: Let G be a simple graph with the degree sequence $(d_1, d_2, ldots,d_n)$. Given a positive integer p, denote the sum of degree powers of G by $e_p(G)=sum_{i=1}^nd_i^p$. The degree power has extensive applications not only in the study of graph structures but also is closely related to graph spectra. In this talk, we show some extremal results on the sum of degree powers of graphs.

data.speakerBio: 徐讯，博士，华大集团首席研究员，基因组多维解析技术全国重点实验室主任，中国科学院大学博士生导师，入选国家重大人才计划。担任国际标准化组织/生物技术委员会ISO/TC276 WG6召集人，全国生物样本标准化委员会（SAC/TC559）专家委员，全国生物表型标准化工作组（SWG34）委员。以第一作者在《Cell》等影响因子30分以上期刊发文7篇，以通讯作者在《Nature》、《Cell》、《Science》主刊发文13篇，近五年他引超8万次，10次入选科睿唯安“全球高被引科学家”。发明专利授权113件，其中国际专利37件。所研发的测序仪获得4项医疗器械证。获得“广东省科学技术奖”一等奖、“深圳市科学技术奖”一等奖，谈家桢生命科学产业化奖、杰出工程师青年奖等。入选百千万人才工程“有突出贡献中青年专家”，享受国务院特殊津贴。
data.abstract: 自从人类基因组计划以来，基因组技术的发展带来了生命科学领域的一系列重大突破。今天的前沿生物技术进展，从DNA测序，到单细胞组学，到时空组学，使我们能以更加深入和全面的角度理解生命的语言，而合成生物学的一系列突破，也使得我们能够改造甚至从头合成生命。这一系列的突破给我们带来了对基因组结构和功能机制链条的全新理解，也带来了在健康、疾病、生物制造等领域的一系列应用突破。

data.abstract: This paper examines how transportation infrastructure affects spatial marriage dynamics with China. Using population census and household survey, we find that a 10 percent increase in high-speed rail (HRS) service intensity raises marriage rates by 0.13 percent in second-tier cities but reduces them by 0.07 percent in third-tier cities, with weaker effects in first-tier cities. Mechanism analyses show that HSR expansion reshapes marriage-related migration, facilitates population movement from first-tier to second-tier cities, improves labor-market opportunities, and lowers fresh food prices in second-tier cities, while weakening firm investment in third-tier cities. Heterogeneity analyses show that marriage effects are concentrated among young adults aged 20–40, with gains for men in second-tier cities and declines for both men and women in third-tier cities. These findings highlight the role of HSR in reshaping spatial population dynamics and marriage behavior.

data.abstract: 本报告探讨分形及无序系统中的非凡物态与量子输运调控。首先,基于分形结构挑战传统体边对应原理,证实了在缺乏绝缘"体"态的系统中仍可存在受拓扑保护的手性边缘态,为拓扑态调控提供了新途径。其次,利用一维无序波导晶格,实现了光子"量子回旋镖"效应的实空间观测,并通过引入对称梯度损耗与时变耦合机制,有效加速并精确控制了波包的回归动力学。最后,在准无序晶格中,验证了扩展、临界及局域态的能谱共存,揭示了相互作用驱动的非单调相变——即非线性反直觉地"融化"冻结的局域态至多重分形临界相。这些研究为在人工晶格平台操控复杂量子态及探索非遍历动力学提供了新路径。

data.abstract: It is well known that the global (in time) well-posedness of mean field game master equations relies on certain monotonicity conditions, and there have been several types of conditions proposed in the literature. In this talk we intend to provide a unified understanding on the role of monotonicity conditions in the theory. Inspired by Lyapunov functions for dynamical systems, we propose a general type of monotonicity condition, which covers all the existing ones as special cases and is essentially necessary for the existence of Lipschitz continuous classical solutions. Our approach works for very general mean field games, including extended mean field games and mean field games with volatility control. In particular, for the latter a new notion of second order monotonicity condition is required. The talk is based on some ongoing joint works with Jianfeng Zhang and Jianjun Zhou.

data.abstract: Considering non-Hermitian systems implemented by utilizing enlarged quantum systems, we determine the fundamental limits for the sensitivity of non-Hermitian sensors from the perspective of quantum information. We prove that non-Hermitian sensors do not outperform their Hermitian counterparts (directly couple to the parameter) in the performance of sensitivity, due to the invariance of the quantum information about the parameter. By scrutinizing two concrete non-Hermitian sensing proposals, which are implemented using full quantum systems, we demonstrate that the sensitivity of these sensors is in agreement with our predictions. Our theory offers a comprehensive and model-independent framework for understanding the fundamental limits of non-Hermitian quantum sensors and builds the bridge over the gap between non-Hermitian physics and quantum metrology.

data.abstract: 敦煌地处河西走廊西端，是镶嵌在丝绸之路上的璀璨明珠，是古代东西方文化交流的桥梁和纽带。长期以来，中原文明与西域文明、古印度文明、古波斯文明等在此相交融，形成了独具特色多元一体的敦煌文化。莫高窟，作为敦煌最负盛名的文化名片，保存了大量洞窟、彩塑及壁画等珍贵文物，展示了敦煌艺术的独特魅力。

data.abstract: We conducted a comparative study of AD detection using the ANMerge cohort of 192 individuals (98 healthy controls and 94 AD patients), which includes demographic information, transcriptomic and metabolomic profiles obtained through three chromatographic modes (HILIC ESI+, RPC ESI+, RPC ESI-). We trained tree-ensemble models AD prediction and assessed performance using validation AUC. Demographics alone achieved AUC 66.3% but added little when other data were available: transcriptomics (76.0%) vs. demographics + transcriptomics (76.3%); HILIC ESI+ (91.7%) vs. HILIC ESI+ + demographics (90.5%). The best performance was the metabolomics model combining HILIC ESI+ and RPC ESI- (AUC 93.0%). Selecting variables with Q-SHAP algorithm, we achieved AUC over 90% with an average of 22.5±1.44 features in demographics + HILIC ESI+ + RPC ESI- (90.7%).While transcriptomic profiles reflect disease states, the metabolomic profile instantly reacts to any change in the dynamic physiological states and is therefore more sensitive to disease status perturbations.

data.abstract: This talk is devoted to the stability of periodic solutions for a free boundary tumor model with a periodic supply of external nutrients. We denote by $\mu$ the tumor aggressiveness constant. We establish a sequence of non-radially symmetric T-periodic solutions bifurcating from the radially symmetric T-periodic solution. And we also investigate the linear stability with respect to non-radial symmetric perturbation, and find a critical threshold of the tumor aggressiveness constant for which the stability changes. This is a joint work with Professor Bei Hu.

data.abstract: In this talk, we consider the critical exponents for the homogeneous evolution p-Laplacian equation $u_{t}-\Delta_{p}u=u^{m}+|\nabla u|^{q}$ and its inhomogeneous version $u_{t}-\Delta_{p}u=u^{m}+|\nabla u|^{q}+h(x)$ in $\mathbb{R}^{N}\times\mathbb{R}^{+}$, $u\geq0$, $u(x,0)=u_{0}(x)$ in $\mathbb{R}^{N}$, where $N\geq1$, $p, m>1$ and $q>1$. We obtain a discontinuous critical exponent result for the homogeneous evolution p-Laplacian equation, which demonstrates the gradient term brings about a significant phenomenon of the critical exponent, changing from $m=p-1+p/N$ to $m=\infty$ as $q$ goes to the value $p-N/(N+1)$ from above. Meanwhile, we also investigate the inhomogeneous evolution p-Laplacian equation and get a different discontinuous critical exponent result. This is a joint work with Heqian Lu.

data.abstract: We build infinitely many geometrically distinct non-radial sign-changing solutions for the Hamiltonian-type elliptic systems $$ -\Delta u =|v|^{p-1}v\ \hbox{in}\ \mathbb R^N,\ -\Delta v =|u|^{q-1}u\ \hbox{in}\ \mathbb R^N,$$ where the exponents $(p,q)$ satisfy $p,q>1$ and belong to the critical hyperbola $$\frac1{p+1}+\frac1{q+1} =\frac {N-2}N.$$ To establish this result, we introduce several new ideas and strategies that are both robust and potentially applicable to other critical problems lacking the Kelvin invariance.

data.abstract: In this talk, we study the global existence of weak solutions for the Cucker-Smale-Navier-Stokes system in an infinitely long cylindrical domain with specular boundary condition. This system models the collective behavior of flocking particles in an incompressible viscous fluid, whereas the specular boundary condition allows particles to collide with the cylinder wall elastically. This generalize the previous results for Stokes type equations, and is the first result to study the flocking particles interacting with Navier-Stokes flows in an infinitely long channel. This involves substantial analytical challenges, especially the treatments of nonlinear convection term. In this work, we overcome these difficulties by employing Ladyzhenskaya's inequality and Gronwall's lemma. Moreover, we establish the flocking estimates and demonstrate convergence toward flocking states asymptotically. Additionally, we perform several numerical simulations to compare the effects of the Navier-Stokes system and its Stokes counterpart and examine the long-time asymptotic behaviors of the corresponding solutions. We also compare the interactions with or without flocking terms, from these simulations, we furthermore conclude that such interactions exhibit shear thinning non-Newtonian flow behaviors.

data.abstract: This talk addresses metastability in stochastic differential equations (SDEs) of the form $$dx_t^{\epsilon}= [-sigma(x_t^{\epsilon})\sigma^T(x_t^{\epsilon})\nabla V(x_t^{\epsilon})+R(x_t^{\epsilon})]dt+\sqrt{2\epsilon}\sigma(x_t^{\epsilon})dW_t \qquad \qquad (1)$$under the assumptions that $\langle R(x),\nabla V(x)\rangle =0$, ${\rm div}R(x)=0$ and $\sigma(x)\sigma^T(x)$ is positive definite pointwise. When the potential $V$ satisfies mild conditions, which hold for polynomial growth at infinity, the system admits a uniform Freidlin-Wentzell large deviations principle and possesses invariant measures. Suppose that the unperturbed system associated with (1) has all maximal equivalent classes $K_1, K_2, ..., K_l$ containing all limit sets. We rigorously characterize the global phase portraits of both the unperturbed system and its extremal equations. If $K_i$ is Lyapunov stable and the boundary of its attracting basin contains $K_j$, then we prove that the quasipotential $V(K_i,K_j)=V(K_j)-V(K_i)=:\Delta V$ from $K_i$ to $K_j$, which implies that the mean transition time from the stable state $K_i$ to the transition state $K_j$ is exponentially large in $O\left(\frac{\Delta V}{\epsilon}\right)$ with exponentially small probability and gives the most probable transition path as well. After computing the transitive difficult matrix $(V(K_i,K_j))_{l\times l}$ and using the Freidlin-Wentzell procedure, we can determine the concentration of limiting measure for the invariant measures of (1) as $\epsilon \rightarrow 0$. For $l\le 4$, we can classify the metastability of (1). For $l > 4$, we provide a programme to carry out the goal.

data.abstract: 睡眠中自发记忆重现对巩固过程至关重要,但传统基于清醒数据的模型难以泛化于节律多变的睡眠 EEG,能否利用头皮脑电实时解码睡眠记忆重现,并在此基础上实现对深部海马活动的闭环调节？我们收集了 135 名健康受试者约 1000 小时夜间睡眠与 400 小时清醒状态的 64 导 EEG 数据,采用对比学习分别训练 NREM 和 REM 阶段的 Sleep Interpreter(SI)模型,实现对 15 类目标记忆的 Top 1 解码(准确率最高达 40.02%);随后在两项独立小睡实验中验证了 SI 离线与在线解码结果与记忆表现的显著相关性;在此基础上,我们构建了闭环经颅聚焦超声刺激(TUS)系统—当 SI 检测到重现信号或进入预设睡眠阶段时,分别触发 θ burst 促进刺激与 β burst 抑制刺激,并结合 2.5 小时静息态与任务态 fMRI 评估海马功能连接与学习记忆行为的双向调控效应。结果表明,该平台不仅能够在睡眠中高精度解码并实时监测记忆重现,还能通过定向 TUS 实现对海马活动的精细双向调节。我们希望这将为揭示睡眠中记忆巩固机制以及开发认知增强与临床干预策略提供了创新范式。

data.abstract: 目前,地理空间人工智能( GeoAI )正在蓬勃发展,其目标是让机器像人类一样进行空间推理和分析,以解决各种地理相关问题或更广泛的问题。这些技术利用了各类位置大数据( Location Big Data ),包括 GPS 或传感器数据、街景数据、社交媒体数据以及众包地理信息等。本报告将总结我们团队在这个领域的最近研究成果,特别是在城市分析和移动性预测方面的应用。我们将重点探讨如何将地理知识、理念和技术融入人工智能( AI ),从而提升 AI 模型的性能,提高其可解释性,并减少所需的训练数据量。 简历黄浩生, 比利时根特大学地理信息科学与地图学教授, GeoAI 研究中心联合主任。 2004年和2006年获得华南师范大学计算机科学专业本科和硕士学位,2013年获得奥地利维也纳技术大学地理信息科学与地图学博士学位。曾任瑞士苏黎世大学地理信息科学中心高级讲师及研究团队负责人(2016-2020),奥地利维也纳技术大学大学助理及讲师(2014-2016)。研究方向为地理信息科学与地图学,位置服务,空间认知及 GeoAI 。担任国际地图协会 ICA副主席,ICA位置服务专委会创会主席, Journal of Location Based Services (Taylor & Francis) 主编, Journal of Maps (Taylor & Francis) 副主编,多个国际期刊(包括 JGSA, CaGIS, GSIS 等)编委及客座主编。

data.abstract: Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM) is central to neuroimaging analysis, detecting associations between brain regions and clinical or genetic predictors. Yet anatomical variability, signal‐pattern heterogeneity, imperfect warping, and acquisition artifacts introduce misalignment errors that undermine accuracy and statistical power. To address these challenges, we propose Regionwise SPM (RW-SPM)—a novel framework that combines region‐based aggregation with adaptive smoothing guided by anatomical landmarks. By partitioning images into small, coherent regions and embedding their aggregated voxel distributions into a Hilbert space, RWSPM enables robust, distribution‐based association testing while remaining computationally efficient. Theoretically and in simulations, RWSPM markedly reduces misalignment bias, controls Type I error rates, and boosts sensitivity. Application to real neuroimaging data confirms its ability to improve both the accuracy and reliability of SPM results. 勷勤数学•专家

data.abstract: The integration of ultra-cold atoms with superconducting circuits creates new opportunities for hybrid quantum systems, where superconducting and atomic components interact through magnetic or electronic couplings. data.abstract: We propose efficient and robust preconditioners for large-scale incompressible flow in highly heterogeneous porous media. We start from the discretization of the first-order form for the single phase incompressible flow and apply a velocity elimination strategy to obtain an equation with pressure as the only unknown. Then an efficient two-grid preconditioner is designed to solve this equation. The key component of the preconditioner is adoption of a non-standard coarse space that contains the media's heterogeneity information. We solve a carefully constructed spectral problem in each coarse element to form the non-standard coarse space. Rich numerical tests with several types of large-scale three-dimensional highly heterogeneous permeability fields are presented. The experimental results show that our generalized multiscale space based preconditioner is robust with respect to the contrast, size and geometry of the permeability fields. We also successfully apply this preconditioner for multiphase flow simulation and transport problems arising from reservoir simulation. We will also introduce how to extend this two-grid preconditioner to multigrid regime.

data.abstract: Sparse linear regression is one of the classic problems in the field of statistics, which has deep connections and high intersections with optimization, computation, and machine learning. To address the effective handling of high-dimensional data, the diversity of real noise, and the challenges in estimating standard deviation of the noise, we propose a novel and general graph-based square-root estimation (GSRE) model for sparse linear regression. Specifically, we use square-root-loss function to encourage the estimators to be independent of the unknown standard deviation of the error terms and design a sparse regularization term by using the graphical structure among predictors in a node-by-node form. Based on the predictor graphs with special structure, we highlight the generality by analyzing that the model in this paper is equivalent to several classic regression models. Theoretically, we also analyze the finite sample bounds, asymptotic normality and model selection consistency of GSRE method without relying on the standard deviation of error terms. In terms of computation, we employ the fast and efficient alternating direction method of multipliers. Finally, based on a large number of simulated and real data with various types of noise, we demonstrate the performance advantages of the proposed method in estimation, prediction and model selection.

data.abstract: We study a finite-horizon consumption and portfolio choice problem incorporating adjustment costs for living standards, with a focus on older individuals. The optimal strategies differ notably between individuals with moderate and high wealth: ordinary individuals reduce consumption and exhibit increasing relative risk aversion, while wealthy individuals increase consumption and exhibit decreasing relative risk aversion until a critical time, after which they shift entirely to safe assets. Our main technical contribution lies in solving this problem via a novel synthesis of four methodologies: the dual martingale approach, transformation into optimal switching problems, partial differential equation techniques—focusing on double obstacle problems—and the Skorokhod lemma.

data.speakerBio: 邹长铃,中国科学技术大学特任教授,博士生导师。依托于郭光灿院士领导的中科院量子信息重点实验室,组建了混合量子集成芯片实验小组。研究聚焦于利用集成光子学技术构建和调控创新型混合量子系统,深入探索其基本物理原理,并致力于开发其在量子信息技术领域的应用。同时,他积极开展量子计算和量子精密测量的理论研究,提出具有前瞻性和可验证性的理论模型与方案。曾荣获多项学术荣誉,包括2019年国家自然科学基金委优秀青年科学基金项目资助、中国光学学会"饶毓泰基础光学奖"、教育部2022年自然科学一等奖、2024年阿里巴巴达摩院"青橙奖最具潜力奖"以及2024年"微腔光学青年科学家奖"。他主持承担了国家重点研发项目课题、国家自然科学基金国际合作项目、重大研究计划重点项目等科研工作。
data.abstract: 集成长相干时间的量子比特与量子功能器件于单一芯片平台,实现全固态量子计算芯片,是量子信息领域的重要研究目标。近年来,光量子芯片和超导量子芯片研究均取得显著突破,在量子比特数量和量子线路复杂度方面不断刷新纪录。尽管这两种芯片平台各具独特优势与发展潜力,但其固有局限性也日益凸显,成为制约发展的瓶颈问题。本报告介绍一种创新的混合量子集成芯片架构——“正甫芯片”。该架构通过引入声子集成器件,巧妙地将各类非悬空声子器件、光子器件及超导量子器件有机整合于同一芯片平台,实现三者之间的相干耦合。基于这一架构,正甫芯片有望为超导量子系统的可扩展性挑战和远程量子连接难题提供新思路,同时为光学量子芯片中的量子存储与单光子非线性量子资源问题开辟创新解决方案。

data.speakerBio: 中山大学心理学系副教授、博士生导师、社会文化与情感神经科学实验室负责人。研究领域主要包括: 1) 计算文化神经科学:自然环境、遗传基础与社会文化环境的协同演化过程,社会文化变迁及其对社会行为的影响; 2) 社会情感神经科学与消极心理学:共情,信任与背叛,从众,撒谎,死亡恐惧等复杂情感过程及行为的神经机制; 3) 面向人类可持续发展的交叉科学:融合地理环境数据、生态生命数据与社会文化心理数据的跨尺度融合研究。研究成果发表在 Neuroscience & Biobehaviral Reviews 、 Social Science & Medicine 、 Globalization and Health 、 NeuroImage 、 British Journal of Social Psychology 、心理学报等国内外权威期刊。部分成果入选 ESI Top 1% 高被引和 ESI Top 0.1% 热点论文,被 Lancet 等国际权威期刊正面引用。先后主持国家自然科学基金多项,各类科研项目十余项。曾担任国家自然科学基金委员会交叉科学部第一届流动项目主任,同时担任中国心理学会社会心理学专业委员会秘书长、国家自然科学基金评审专家、新加坡国家医学研究基金国际评审专家、《 The Innovation 》青年编委、《 Social Cognitive and Affective Neuroscience 》、《 BMC Psychology 》编委及三十余个学术期刊审稿人。
data.abstract: 气候变化与人类可持续发展是全人类共同面对的重大挑战,解决该问题需要心理学与地球科学、环境科学、计算科学、人类学等多学科交叉融合协同攻关。文化帮助人类适应自然,然而此前关于文化的研究大多从还原论视角出发针对单一尺度和单一维度特征进行研究。我们提出文化组学( Culturomics )跨尺度交叉科学研究框架,从系统科学视角认识与理解文化,探索气候变化与人类文化文明演变之间的联系。我们将从中国传统文化中的天人合一思想出发,交叉融合仿真人工社会、历史民族志、跨文化测评、心理行为实验和神经影像技术,结合人工智能大语言模型和表征相似性分析跨尺度分析方法,通过系列研究揭示天气变异性如何通过改变人类的环境适应性行为,从而塑造人类社会的文化价值观,并揭示其心理机制、神经基础和演化模式。

data.speakerBio: 吴泉生,中科院物理所HM-T03组特聘研究员。他于2013年获得中科院物理所博士学位,2015-2021年期间先后在苏黎世联邦理工学院(ETHZ)和洛桑联邦理工学院(EPFL)进行博士后研究,2021年底加入物理所。他的主要研究领域是拓扑材料及其输运性质和机器学习在凝聚态中的应用。他在Science、Nature、PRL等重要杂志上发表了多篇文章,Google引用12000余次,H因子34。由他主导开发的WannierTools软件成为拓扑材料领域的重要工具,软件引用超过2300次。
data.abstract: 本报告将介绍一种第一性原理计算结合半经典玻尔兹曼输运理论用以定量计算真实材料的磁阻和Hall效应。将讨论拓扑平凡与拓扑材料中磁输运现象的不饱和磁阻效应,揭示了载流子补偿、开放轨道机制及费米面拓扑的关键作用。研究表明,理论预测与典型金属、半金属及外尔半金属的低温实验结果高度一致,同时发现科勒定律适用于霍尔电阻率,阐明了普通霍尔效应与异常霍尔效应的比例关系和内在规律。针对窄隙半导体的异常电阻峰值及霍尔电阻率符号反转,我们提出了一种基于多载流子动力学和费米面几何的统一解释。引入的新方法成功解释了磁性材料中复杂的磁阻和霍尔效应行为,与实验高度吻合,突显了费米面形状和平均散射时间对输运性质的决定性作用。同时我们还将介绍磁场下的rho-T曲线的奇异行为的新解释。我们的研究为理解磁输运现象提供了新理论框架,并为材料分类和特性表征开辟了新的路径。

data.abstract: Ultracold quantum gases offer a unique setup for quantum simulation of interacting many-body systems. The high degree of controllability and the novel detection possibilities in these quantum systems provide an exciting complementary setup compared with condensed-matter physics. One of the most interesting directions in quantum simulations with ultracold atoms is to combine topological quantum matter and strongly correlated systems. In this talk, I will review the recent processes in a number of experimental areas, and recent advance in our group, where we mainly focus on the interplay of topology, interactions, and non-equilibrium dynamics of ultracold gases in optical lattices. Firstly, I will focus on topology in far-from-equilibrium relaxation dynamics in interacting lattices. Here, we propose a protocol based on time-evolved stationary states of ultracold interacting bosonic gases in an optical lattice to study nontrivial topology of high-lying excited states. Secondly, I will talk about universal dynamics of far-from-equilibrium transport of strongly interacting topological systems.

data.abstract: It is well known that, in the study of the dynamical properties of nonlinear evolution system with nonlocal dispersals, the sign of the principal eigenvalue of linearized system play an important role. However, in the case of variable coefficients, in order to obtain the existence of principal eigenvalue for the cooperative and irreducible system, very strong conditions must be attached to the coefficients. In this paper we study the cooperative and irreducible system. We approximate the spectral bound of the operator and provide a characterization by constructing the monotonic upper and lower control systems with principal eigenvalues; and show that the spectral bound plays the same role as the usual principal eigenvalue.

data.abstract: We provide comprehensive validation of Ludwig Boltzmann's hypotheses, as articulated in his seminal work in 1867, within the framework of the Landau equation in the presence of a harmonic potential. Our study verifies that: (i) Each {\it entropy-invariant solution} corresponds to a {\it time-periodic Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution}. Additionally, these distributions are governed by thirteen conservation laws. (ii) Each {\it time-periodic Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution} demonstrates nonlinear stability, including neutral asymptotic stability and Lyapunov stability. The rate of convergence is intricately connected to these thirteen conservation laws and is optimal in comparison to the linear case. Significantly, these results suggest that the {\it time-periodic Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution} $M$ acts as the "asymptotic state" for solutions to the equation that share the same conservation laws as $M$.

data.abstract: We are concerned with a class of Hamiltonian elliptic systems. By blowing-up technique and Liouville theorem, we prove the uniqueness of positive solutions to a Hamiltonian elliptic system with general nonlinearity in the whole space. In addition, as an application, we obtain positive solutions concentrating around saddle points of potentials for singularly perturbed system with supercritical growth.

data.abstract: The 90-minute ultradian rhythm is a defining characteristic of human sleep, yet the underlying mechanism for this rhythm remains elusive. Here, we introduce a biologically plausible sleep model aimed at elucidating the intricate dynamical mechanisms that govern this phenomenon. Our model encapsulates both circadian and ultradian rhythms, shaping the architecture of sleep. It incorporates transitions between wakefulness, rapid eye movement (REM) sleep, and non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep, represented by 'flip-flop' switches. By calibrating our model with empirically derived parameters, we have successfuly replicated typical sleep patterns, accurately reproducing the 24-hour circadian rhythm alongside the 90-minute ultradian rhythm. Utilizing the theory of potential landscapes, we reveal the fundamental physical mechanisms that orchestrate transitions between different brain states. This provides a quantitative assessment of global stability, influenced by factors such as circadian drive, sleep homeostatic drive, and REM sleep pressure. To specifically investigate the ultradian rhythm, we streamline our comprehensive sleep model into a two-component framework focusing on NREM and REM sleep. This analytical reduction simplifies the potential function to a quartic two-well potential, clearly delineating NREM and REM sleep stages. By combining bifurcation analysis with the resonance principle, we propose that the 90-minute ultradian rhythm arises from the resonance between the weak ultradian drive and the simplified system.

data.abstract: This talk focuses on the dynamic analysis, control and applications of impulsive systems. Specifically, the concept of average impulsive interval will be introduced and, based on this concept, a unified synchronization criterion for impulsive dynamical networks is established. Furthermore, a new concept of average impulsive delay is introduced to characterize impulsive delays from a holistic perspective. In addition, unlike previous results on the "negative" effect of delay on the stability of impulsive systems, this talk will show the potential "positive" effect of delay on the stability of impulsive systems. Finally, impulsive control is successfully applied to stabilization of networked systems under denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. These applications demonstrate that impulsive controllers are very robust to a wide range of DoS attackers, even if their attack parameters (DoS duration and DoS frequency) are previously unknown to the control designer.

data.speakerBio: 雷浩，现为教育部人文社会科学重点研究基地华东师范大学课程与教学研究所副所长，教授、博士生导师。入选国家级青年人才，Elsevier2023年中国高被引学者（教育学）等。主要从事课程改革与教材使用，课程开发等研究。主持国家社科基金（教育学）“十四五”规划国家重点、国家一般、“十三五”国家青年课题。近年来在《Journal of Computer Assisted Learning》《教育研究》等国内外重要期刊发表学术论文80余篇。出版《为学而教：学习中心教学的研究》等专著，参与主编《义务教育课程方案（2022年版）解读》。相关研究成果入选ESI全球高被引论文，荣获高等学校优秀科研成果奖二等奖、青年成果奖，上海市哲学社会科学优秀成果奖一等奖、学术新锐奖，全国教育科学研究优秀成果二等奖、三等奖，国家级教学成果一等奖等奖励。

data.abstract: 气候风险作为关乎人类存亡的重要问题,引发各国政府部门、新闻媒体和学术界的广泛关注。本文以异常降水(降水的标准差)作为测度气候风险的指标,并据此考察气候风险对于经济脱实入虚的潜在影响。

data.abstract: Understanding the transition mechanism of boundary layer flows is of great significance in physics and engineering, especially due to the current development of supersonic and hypersonic aircraft. In this talk, we show some results about the linear instability of boundary layer flow: 1. For the incompressible case, we confirm the existence of neutral curve by constructing stable and neutral stable Tollmien-Schlichting waves. 2. We construct the unstable Tollmien-Schlichting waves of both temporal and spatial mode to the linearized compressible Navier-Stokes system around the boundary layer flow in the whole subsonic regime. 3. We construct multiple unstable acoustic modes so called Mack modes, which plays a crucial role during the early stage of transition in the supersonic boundary layer.

data.abstract: In crystalline solids, the interplay between topology and interactions can lead to various exotic topological correlated states, i.e., the recently discovered fractional Chern insulators (FCIs). Graphene based topological flat-bands provide a clean and highly tunable platform to investigate these states. In this talk, I will introduce our recent experiments on the observation of FCIs in rhombohedral hexalayer graphene (RHG)/hBN moiré superlattices and unconventional Chern insulators in magic angle bilayer graphene.

data.abstract: This paper formulates a general time-inconsistent linear quadratic mean-field Stackelberg differential game. We define the equilibrium strategies for the follower and the leader, which are two open-loop controls. The sufficient conditions for equilibrium controls are derived via two flows of forward-backward stochastic differential equations. Finally, we consider a Stackelberg game between a pension manager and the policy holders as an application. Applying the general sufficient condition, we obtain equilibrium strategies for the pension manager and the policy holders.

data.abstract: 原子级极限尺度的铁电性对于实现高集成度、低功耗的非易失性光电子芯片至关重要。然而,传统铁电材料的自发极化在原子尺度往往难以存续。2021年,二维界面滑移铁电的首次实验观测为实现极限尺度铁电性提供了新的思路:自发极化发生在菱形堆垛的二维材料界面,并在双层极限尺度保持稳定。在这个报告中,我将介绍近期在二维界面滑移铁电体系中基本物理机制的研究,重点探讨界面自发极化的物理来源、自发极化反转的物理机制,以及相关体系在光电探测等领域中的应用前景。

data.speakerBio: 渠岩，广州美术学院城乡艺术建设研究院院长、教授，中国社会科学院主编《中国乡村文化发展报告》蓝皮书编委、中国文化产业协会乡村文化创意专业委员会副会长、中国首个可持续乡村建设实践奖——“乡筑未來奖”评委、联合教科文组织当代艺术创意与可持续发展专家委员会委员。渠岩是中国20世纪“八五新潮”时期的当代艺术家，作品涵盖绘画、装置、摄影、建筑以及社会参与性艺术等，参加上百次国际与国内重要的当代艺术展览。渠岩是新时期，“中国艺术乡建新浪潮”最早的发起者之一。
data.abstract: 渠岩通过20年身体力行的社会介入行动与乡村建设实践，深入系统的思考中国传统乡村文化价值与乡村价值，同时也是重估艺术的价值，艺术不仅是一套审美体系，也是一套观念和价值系统，其承载着人类追求新生活的向往和理想。渠岩积极协调与整合各种社会资源介入乡村，通过“联动”实践，激活乡村文化的主体性复苏，力图修复被长期的社会建设所破坏的“天、地、人、神”关系，建构以乡村和村民为主体的“情感共同体”。印证了社会介入的艺术家如何成为一个理想的“行动者”和有行动的“思考者”。

data.abstract: 磁斯格明子是一种受拓扑保护的、具有涡旋磁结构的准粒子,具有易操控、尺寸小、驱动速度快等优点,是未来自旋电子学存储和逻辑运算器件的理想信息载体。对磁斯格明子高效地、精准地操控是其在实际器件应用中的关键。但是,这种操控仍然面临着极大的挑战。在该报告中,我首先介绍磁斯格明子以及其实现的传统方案。然后,讨论我们在二维范德华Janus铬基磁性单层中发现的高温铁磁以及这类体系中由外磁场诱发的磁斯格明子。在此基础上,介绍我们在范德华多铁异质结CrSeI/In2Te3中发现的由铁电极化翻转诱发的磁斯格明子和高温铁磁之间的转换,并给出该转换的物理机制以及类似多铁异质结中出现磁斯格明子的普适描述符。最后,展望二维磁性体系中磁斯格明子未来的研究方向！

data.speakerBio: 叛逆者追踪( traitor tracing )系统是一种多接收方加密,允许权威机构或任意方(在公共可追踪性的情况下)识别出合谋创建了盗版解码器的恶意用户(叛逆者)。 跟踪和撤销( trace-and-revoke )系统是叛逆者跟踪系统的扩展,其中,存在一个用户撤销机制,用来撤销用户(例如,叛逆者)的解密能力。 追踪和撤销系统在广播加密( BE )、基于身份加密( IBE )和基于属性加密( ABE )下得到了广泛的研究,但在函数加密( FE )下研究较少。 本报告将介绍我们构造的一个可追踪和可撤销内积函数加密通用性方案,该工作发表在 ESORICS 2022 。 报告人2: 罗富财,现为浙江工商大学副研究员。主要从事公钥密码、格密码、全同态加密以及可证明安全理论的基础理论和应用研究。在 CCF 推荐会议和期刊上以第一作者身份发表近 20 篇论文,包括 IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security, IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing, IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing, Designs, Codes and Cryptography,Theoretical Computer Science, The Computer Journal, ESORICS 2022 。主持一项国家自然科学基金青年项目。 华南师范大学
data.abstract: A recent line of works on zero-knowledge (ZK) protocols with a vector oblivious linear function evaluation (VOLE)-based offline phase provides a new paradigm for scalable ZK protocols featuring fast proving and small prover memory. Very recently, Baum et al. (Crypto'23) proposed the VOLE-in-the-head technique, allowing such protocols to become publicly verifiable. Many practically efficient protocols for proving circuit satisfiability over any Galois field are implemented, while protocols over rings ℤ _{2^k} are significantly lagging behind, with only a proof-of-concept pioneering work called Appenzeller to Brie (CCS'21) and a first proposal called Moz ℤ _{2^k}arella (Crypto ' 22). The ring ℤ _{2^{32}} or ℤ _{2^{64}} , though highly important (it captures computation in real-life programming and the computer architectures such as CPU words), presents non-trivial difficulties because, for example, unlike Galois fields F_{2^k} , the fraction of units in ℤ _{2^k} is 1/2. In this work, we first construct ZK protocols over a high degree Galois ring extension of ℤ _{2^k} (fraction of units close to 1) and then convert them to ℤ _{2^k} efficiently using amortization techniques. Our results greatly change the landscape of ZK protocols over ℤ _{2^k}. (1) We propose a competing ZK protocol that has many advantages over the state-of-the-art Moz ℤ _{2^k} are lla. We remove the undesirable dependence of communication complexity on the security parameter, and achieve (strict) linear communication complexity. Furthermore, our protocol has better concrete efficiency. For 40, 80 bits soundness on 32, 64-bit CPUs, we offer 1.15×–2.9× improvements in communication. (2) Inspired by the recently proposed interactive message authentication code technique (Weng et al., CCS'22), we construct a constant round ZK protocol over ℤ _{2^k} with sublinear (in the circuit size) communication complexity, which was previously achieved only over fields. (3) We adapt the VOLE-in-the-head technique, and apply it to our first ZK protocol, yielding the first publicly verifiable non-interactive ZK over ℤ _{2^k} with linear communication complexity. Also, we show that the pseudorandom correlation generator approach (incompatible with VOLE-in-the-head) can be adapted to efficiently implement VOLE over Galois rings, with analysis of the hardness of underlying assumptions. 报告人1: 林富春,现为上海交通大学助理研究员,博士毕业于新加坡南洋理工大学( Nanyang Technological University ),先后在加拿大卡尔加里大学( University of Calgary )和英国帝国理工学院( Imperial College London )从事博士后研究,在编码与密码领域取得一系列重要成果:( 1 )基于代数格的安全编码和密码方面成果在信息论顶级期刊《 IEEE Trans. Information Theory 》、《中国科学》等国内外学术期刊发表;( 2 )基于代数编码的安全编码和密码协议方面成果在"四大安全顶会"之一的 CCS 、 INFOCOM 等国际学术会议发表;( 3 )秘密共享与安全多方计算方面成果在"三大密码会"的 Crypto 、 ASIACRYPT 、 ITCS 、 ITC 等国际学术会议发表。参与编写由国际 CRC 出版社出版的《 Physical Layer Security in Wireless Communications 》著作,主要负责" Coding for wiretap channels "部分编写;担任 FOCS 、 EUROCRYPT 、 ASIACRYPT 、 IEEE Trans. data.abstract: It was well known that geometric considerations enter in a decisive way in many questions of analysis. As Meyer, the recipient of the 2017 Abel Prize, remarked "One is amazed by the dramatic changes that occurred in analysis during the twentieth century. In the 1930s complex methods and Fourier series played a seminal role. After many improvements, mostly achieved by the Calder´on–Zygmund school, the action takes place today on spaces of homogeneous type.No group structure is available, the Fourier transform is missing, but a version of harmonic analysis is still present. Indeed the geometry is conducting the analysis."In this talk, we will concentrate on questions that how the geometrical considerations play a crucial role in the theory of singular integrals. We will attempt to give a broad overview of the descriptions of the singular integrals, such as, nonstandard singular integrals which include the flag singular integrals, singular integrals in the Dunkl setting and the singular integrals associated with the Zygmund dilations.

data.abstract: 意识是神经科学的一个核心课题,包括两个主要成分:觉醒水平和意识内容。在慢波睡眠和麻醉状态下,这两者都会降低;无反应觉醒综合征(也称植物状态)患者虽能睁眼(表现较高觉醒水平),但缺乏意识内容;在快速眼动睡眠中,觉醒水平低,但意识内容则相对丰富。尽管对意识内容的神经机制已有广泛研究,觉醒水平的神经基础却仍然未知。本次报告针对该问题展开,介绍我们通过分析多种觉醒状态的功能磁共振数据(包括多种睡眠阶段、麻醉、静息睁闭眼、无反应觉醒综合征),发现丘脑腹后外侧核与全脑的共激活主要与觉醒水平相关,而非意识内容,从而揭示与觉醒特异相关的神经机制。

data.speakerBio: Dr. Xiao Yuan received his Bachelor in theoretical physics from Peking University in 2012 and got his PhD in physics from Tsinghua University in 2016. Then he worked as a postdoc at University of Science and Technology of China in 2017, at Oxford University from 2017 to 2019, and at Stanford University from 2019 to 2020. He is now an assistant professor at Center on Frontiers of Computing Studies, Peking University. Dr. Xiao Yuan’s current research interests focus on near-term and universal quantum computing, and their applications.
data.abstract: Quantum computer could solve classically intractable problems. While since realizing a universal quantum computer is challenging with current technology, a more practical question before having a fully-fledged quantum computer is what we can do with current and near-term quantum hardware. Focusing on the noisy-intermediate-scaled-quantum regime, we introduce variational quantum algorithms for solving static and dynamic problems of many-body physics. Considering the limitations on the qubits number and circuit depth, we introduce the hybrid tensor network and perturbative quantum simulation methods that allow us to solve practical large problems. With the rapid development of quantum hardware, variational quantum algorithms may finally enable genuine quantum advantage demonstration in the noisy-intermediate-scaled quantum era..

data.abstract: High-precision calculation is one of the frontiers in the field of high-energy physics. One of the main aspects of high-precision calculation in high-energy physics is the calculation of Feynman integrals. The standard procedure to calculate Feynman integrals is as follows. Firstly we use the Integration-by-Parts (IBP) method to express a Feynman integral as a linear combination of the so-called master integrals. Then we evaluate the master integrals by using the differential-equation method either numerically or analytically. We refer to the step of expressing Feynman integrals in terms of master integrals the reduction of Feynman integrals. In recent years, the speaker has developed a method to reduce Feynman integrals based on the Feynman-parameter representation. This method has several advantages compared to traditional approaches. Recently, we have further combined this method with the differential-equation method and develop a technique to calculate Feynman integrals recursively. Experiences show that this method surpasses existing methods on both efficiency and accuracy in many cases. In this presentation, the speaker will provide a detailed introduction to these methods.

data.abstract: We consider sparse representations of signals from redundant dictionaries which are unions of several orthonormal bases. The spark introduced by Donoho and Elad plays an important role in sparse representations. However, numerical computations of sparks are generally combinatorial. For unions of several orthonormal bases, two lower bounds on the spark via the mutual coherence were established in previous work. We constructively prove that both of them are tight. Our main results give positive answers to Gribonval and Nielsen's open problem on sparse representations in unions of orthonormal bases. Constructive proofs rely on a family of mutual unbiased bases which first appears in quantum information theory. It is joint work with Prof. Song Li, Dr. Yuan Shen and Chenyun Yu.

data.abstract: 就业是民生之本,扩大就业渠道以实现区域就业稳定是维持经济增长与社会和谐的重要课题。本文致力于探究市场监管机构改革所发挥稳定就业的效果及其机制。理论上,市场监管改革有利于塑造公平竞争的市场环境,有助于削减企业创立的制度性交易成本,从而能够激励企业进入市场。然而,不同产业类型企业在创立时需要固定资产投入不同,由此产业结构将偏向固定资产投入较少的第三产业发展;同时第三产业具有劳动密集型的特征,能够通过吸纳更多劳动力最终实现区域就业稳定。实证上,本文运用多期双重差分(Time-varying DID)模型,结合中国城市层面相关就业数据以及微观企业创立数据,进行计量分析发现:市场监管改革提高了当地的就业水平,突出表现为城镇私营和个体从业人员以及城镇总就业人员占总人口比重的显著上升。机制分析发现,市场监管改革显著改善了当地的营商环境,促进了更大比重的第三产业企业进入市场,引发产业结构转型的同时导致就业人数显著上升。本文立足于稳定就业这一党和政府迫切关注的重大社会问题,首次验证了市场监管改革对劳动力市场施加的积极作用,为实现区域就业市场的稳步发展提供了新的视角和证据,对国家相关就业政策的制定和实施具有充分的参考价值和启示意义。

data.abstract: In this talk, we study some basic properties of dual quaternion matrices, which including singular values, polar decomposition, (appreciable) rank equalities and inequalities, the Courant-Fischer minimax principle, trace, and Weyl type monotonicity inequality. We also propose two variants of the above two inequalities expressed by eigenvalues of dual quaternion Hermitian matrices, and establish an Eckart-Young type low-rank approximation theorem and reverse Eckart-Young Theorem. 学术

data.abstract: High-energy physics is facing challenges, such as understanding the origin of observed baryon asymmetry and the nature of dark matter. Scenarios to address these challenges often involve dynamics that, at present, cannot be solved due to computational or theoretical limitations. An elegant solution exists in the form of real-time simulation with quantum computers, though hampered by limited quantum resources for the foreseeable future. In my talk, I will motivate the critical need for real-time simulation in high-energy physics, discuss existing challenges/theoretical developments involved when formulating quantum field theory on a quantum computer, and extracting physical quantities from it in the continuum limit.

data.abstract: We test the seminal Grossman and Hart (1988) model on the optimality of the one-share-one-vote (OSOV) share structure against the dual-class share (DCS) structure in a laboratory experiment. We show qualitative support to their theoretical prediction asserting that the more efficient contender of control (incumbent or raider) is more likely to win the takeover contest under OSOV than DCS. We also find that the price deviation from the fundamental value is smaller under OSOV than DCS. Overall, our results show supportive evidence for better allocation and information efficiency of OSOV relative to DCS.

data.abstract: 宗族文化作为非正式制度的重要组成部分是否会对企业信贷违约行为产生影响?以沪深A股上市公司作为研究对象,本文实证检验了宗族文化如何影响企业贷款违约行为。结果显示,宗族文化密度越大的地区,企业贷款违约的概率越低,这说明宗族文化可以抑制企业贷款违约行为。作用机制检验证实,宗族文化通过降低代理成本与创新投入两个渠道降低企业贷款违约的概率。异质性分析表明,宗族文化对企业信贷违约行为的抑制作用在高管为本地人的企业,民营企业,以及经济基础较差、市场化程度较低的地区更为显著。进一步研究发现,宗族文化有助于缓解企业融资约束,具体表现为企业获得的总贷款尤其是短期贷款显著增加。

data.abstract: Landau's Fermi liquid theory is the foundation of modern condensed matter physics. Strong correlation mediated by critical bosons renders Landau's quasiparticle picture broken down which amounts to a non-Fermi liquid (NFL) metal. Distinct types of NFLs can be classified according to the momentum carried by the critical boson. This leads to the ferromagnetic/anti-ferromagnetic quantum criticality and the NFL state in the associated quantum critical regime. In the first part of the talk, I will introduce a novel type of NFL induced by infinite many bosons that simultaneously become critical on a continuous manifold. This constitutes the scenario of infinity scatter infinity which is studied by complementary theoretical frameworks. The physical consequence for the infinite critical boson NFL is demonstrated in both three and two spatial dimensions.In the second part, I turn to the investigation of using ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) as a new probe for the strongly correlated phases of matter without quasiparticles. Properties of the NFL metallic phase can be read off from the modulations on the FMR. The characteristic frequency and temperature dependence of the FMR modulations is analytically derived for the Ising-nematic quantum criticality-induced NFL.

data.abstract: 金属表面的化学反应在非均相催化以及纳米结构生长等复杂过程中都起着重要的作用。在较低的温度下,这些反应一般沿着最低能量路径进行。这时,温度效应可以通过谐振子模型描述。当反应温度很高甚至接近表面材料的熔点时,整个表面结构变得高度无序。这时,偏离最低能量路径的高能结构也十分重要。我们对高温反应的一般性规律目前还知之甚少。在本报告中,通过基于机器学习势的大规模分子动力学模拟,我们发现几种重要的高温效应,包括局域化学环境、表面原子迁移以及衬底材料热膨胀。这些效应对反应速率常数以及反应物和产物的平衡浓度和扩散率有不同的影响。这些结果加深了我们对高温表面化学反应的认识。

data.abstract: The discovery of neutrino oscillations reveals that neutrinos are massive and lepton flavor mixing exists. In this talk, I shall explain why and how we construct low-energy effective theories of canonical seesaw models at the one-loop level. The one-loop renormalization-group equations of physical parameters in the seesaw effective field theory are also derived. Such a construction provides us with a self-consistent framework for the low-energy precision tests of the seesaw models at high-energy scales.

data.abstract: We are interested in the threshold phenomena for propagation in nonlocal diffusion equations with some compactly supported initial data. In the so-called bistable and ignition cases, we provide the first quantitative estimates for such phenomena. The outcomes dramatically depend on the tails of the dispersal kernel and can take a large variety of different forms. The strategy is to combine sharp estimates of the tails and the construction of accurate sub- and super-solutions. 学术

data.abstract: 基于编码的公钥密码能有效抵抗量子计算机的攻击已经成为后量子公钥密码的重要类型之一，绝大多数基于编码的公钥方案的安全性是基于校验子译码困难问题。 校验子译码问题的实际安全性是指抵抗现有的各种攻击的能力，精准地估计相应的公钥密码方案的具体安全性和选择方案的参数集。因此本报告的主要内容是介绍目前求解校验子译码问题最好的通用算法——信息集合译码算法的发展历史、一般框架、关键技术点以及重要的信息集合译码算法--MMT算法。

data.abstract: 自 从 2015年激光 干 涉引 力 波天 文 台( LIGO) 首 次直接探测到引 力 波,基于引 力 波的研究得到了快速发展。这 一 独 立 于电磁波外的全新探测 手 段为基础物理的研究打开了新的窗 又 ,为粒 子 物理和宇宙学 方面一 些基本问题的解决提供了新的思路,如宇宙中物质反物质不对称问题、暗物质本质问题等。本次报告中,我将介绍 一 些相关的研究,包括早期宇宙中的 一 阶相变过程产 生 的引 力 波、量 子 场论中的拓扑类和 非 拓扑类孤 子 基于引 力 波的探测等,侧重于阐述如何从微观粒 子 产 生 宏观上的引 力 波。

data.abstract: 关于洋务企业如何影响近代中国工业发展仍存分歧。本文认为,洋务企业通示范效应、企业转制和铁路建设三个渠道推动近代中国民营工业发展。本文根据张玉法晚清新式工业企业原始资料构造1861-1911年府级面板数据。实证研究发现,洋务企业促进本府民营企业发展,GMM和IV估计结果仍然稳健。洋务企业的影响以本府为主,空间溢出性呈现以省内中心府向外围递减的特征,其影响主要源于1895年前官督商办企业的作用,主要是促进轻工业民营企业的发展;洋务企业推动铁路建设,其影响在开通铁路的府更大。本文为理解中国工业化早期国有企业和民营企业之间的关系提供了历史经验证据。

data.abstract: 近十年来,几何拓扑相关的物理学研究领域受到研究人员们的广泛关注。特别是在光学领域,拓扑光子学俨然成为了目前的研究热点之一。光子晶体作为微纳光学系统中最基本最常见的研究对象,常常作为一种电子系统的光学模拟和对应,进而在光学拓扑绝缘体的研究中扮演者重要的角色。本报告首先介绍了微纳光学和拓扑绝缘体的相关基本概念和知识。接着,结合国内外和课题组最新的研究进展,系统的介绍了光学拓扑绝缘体的发展历程和关键研究突破。最后,对微纳光学及光学拓扑绝缘体的发展前景进行分析和展望。

data.abstract: 量子网络可应用于分布式量子计算、量子通信及量子精密测量,是当前国际前沿热点研究课题。冷原子由于相干性好、操控手段丰富,在量子网络的组网中具有重要应用潜力。本报告首先将介绍冷原子与量子网络的研究背景及基本概念;之后结合国内外及本团队的研究进展,系统介绍冷原子量子网络的组网关键技术研究进展,包括单光子源、量子存储、固体比特量子接口等;最后将展望量子网络研究前景。

data.abstract: In this talk, we develop some neural network models for the computation of the quaternion singular value decomposition (QSVD). data.abstract: 构建精准有效的创新激励政策工具组合,激励企业创新能力提升是实现科技自立自强的关键。本文利用广东省科技型企业数据,实证检验了差异化的创新激励政策工具组合对企业创新链不同阶段的影响。研究发现:自由裁量型和选择型政策工具组合能显著促进企业基础研究和应用研究;不同政策工具组合均对企业试验发展阶段无显著正向影响;进一步地,本文还考察了所有制和企业规模在政策工具组合对企业创新链影响的调节效应。结果显示,企业规模越大,自由裁量型和选择型政策工具越能显著提升企业基础研究。国有企业和非国有企业在政策组合与企业基础研究和应用研究中的调节效应不显著。本文不仅丰富了创新激励政策的相关研究,而且为政府构建高效、协调、精准和有效的创新政策工具组合提供实证依据和思考方向。

data.abstract: We consider the market design problem of matching students to schools in the presence of crowding effects. These effects are salient in parents' decision making and the empirical literature; however, they cause major difficulties in the design of satisfactory mechanisms and, as such, are not currently considered. We propose a new framework and an equilibrium notion that accommodates crowding, no-envy, and respect for priorities. The equilibrium has a student-optimal element that induces an incentive compatible mechanism and is implementable via a novel algorithm. Moreover, analogs of fundamental structural results of the matching literature---the Rural Hospitals Theorem, welfare lattice, etc.---survive.

data.abstract: 在粒子物理中,标准模型精确的描述了夸克轻子等微观粒子的相互作用。同时宇宙学标准模型也精确描述了宇宙早期至今的演化。但是仍然有很多问题亟待解决。例如,为什么中微子有微小的质量、宇宙早期的快速膨胀 (暴胀)是如何发生的、为什么我们的可见物质是以重子物质为主,反重子却很少。我们最近研究发现(Phys. Rev. Lett. 128, 141801),如果在标准模型基础上只引入一个新粒子——希格斯三重态,上述三个问题将会得到同时解决。其中,中微子质量是由希格斯三重态的真空破缺产生,暴胀是由标准模型希格斯和希格斯三重态的混合态提供,而重子不对称性可以通过 Affleck-Dine机制来实现,从而使得上述三个问题得到同时解决。另一方面,该模型预言希格斯三重态只能衰变到两个轻子,从而为其在对撞机上的直接寻找提供了独特的检验信号,同时该粒子也可以在轻子味破坏的实验中进行间接寻找。此模型预言中微子必然是马约拉纳费米子,未来的无中微子双贝塔衰变实验将会对此预言进行验证。同时该模型预言的宇宙学信号也可以在未来的宇宙微波背景辐射实验LiteBIRD上进行检验。

data.speakerBio: 袁岑溪,中山大学中法核工程与技术学院副教授、博士生导师、副院长。分别于2006年和2012年获北京大学理学学士和博士,博士期间受国家公派赴东京大学联合培养,博士毕业后入职中山大学中法核工程与技术学院,历任讲师、副教授、博士生导师。主要研究方向是核物理与反应堆物理,在PRL、PLB、PRC等物理学主流刊物发表SCI收录论文71篇。2019年获中国核物理学会唯一奖项胡济民教育科学奖、2017年入选广东省科技创新青年拔尖人才、2015年入选广州市珠江科技新星。
data.abstract: 随着新一代核物理加速器能力的提高,越来越多的远离稳定线的极端丰中子和丰质子原子核被发现和研究。但相比于可能存在的束缚原子核,目前实验条件下能观测和测量的仍是少数,大量原子核的性质仍需借助理论工具描述。原子核壳模型是理论研究这些原子核性质的重要工具,本报告将回顾从从轻核到重核的壳模型研究。有效相互作用壳模型目前在不同区域使用不同的有效相互作用,本报告初步探讨基于统一有效核力的壳模型研究。

data.speakerBio: 褚智勤教授先后于西北大学（中国）物理系基地班和香港中文大学物理系获得学士和博士学位，此后在德国斯图加特大学从事博士后研究，自 2018 年 11 月开始任职于香港大学工程学院电机与电子工程学系担任助理教授。曾在物理学，生物医学，材料科学，光子学和生物学交叉研究领域发表多篇高影响力论文，包括 Nature Communications, JACS, Biomaterials, Nano Letters, Advanced Science 等国际期刊共约 50 余篇，被引用 1100 余次。褚智勤教授团队目前主要的研究方向包括量子传感与探测，生物物理，生物力学和生物光子学的相关研究。
data.abstract: The diamond has been well known as the gem stones in jewellery market, and the same material with various atomic defects, i.e., fluorescent impurities in diamond lattice, shows unique quantum behaviors even at ambient conditions. Due to their superior properties, this atomic-sized sensor has been demonstrated to achieve nanometric measurement of various physical quantities such as electromagnetic fields, temperature and etc. in complicated environments. Here we will mainly discuss the development of diamond quantum technology, a technique that will revolutionize our understanding of the world at the very small scales. With the objective of exploiting this quantum technology, we will report on our recent progress in its applications from science to industry.

data.abstract: When a weak-brand firm and a strong-brand firm source from a common contract manufacturer, the weak-brand firm may advertise this relationship to promote its own product. This paper investigates whether the weak-brand firm should use such brand spillover as a marketing strategy and how this decision depends on the firms' characteristics and market conditions. We develop a game theoretic model consisting of one contract manufacturer and two firms with asymmetric brand power. The contract manufacturer determines the wholesale prices for the two firms and then each firm decides whether to source from the contract manufacturer. If both firms outsource to the contract manufacturer, then the weak-brand firm may choose whether to promote its product through brand spillover. Although brand spillover improves the attractiveness of the weak-brand firm's product at no cost, we find that the weak-brand firm should not use brand spillover if (1) its original brand power is sufficiently low or (2) the contract manufacturer does not have a significant cost advantage. Interestingly, the adoption of brand spillover by the weak-brand firm can benefit all three parties under certain circumstances, including the strong-brand firm. Nevertheless, when the contract manufacturer has a significant cost advantage, in equilibrium the strong-brand firm will be hurt by brand spillover and hence should take actions to prevent it.

data.abstract: 流动人口为中国经济增长做出了巨大贡献,逾六成流动人口家庭选择让子女随迁而非留守。现有研究聚焦于留守儿童相对于非留守儿童的人力资本损失,忽略了流动儿童在城市生活的困境。本文利用流动人口监测数据研究发现,流动儿童的受教育水平不仅低于城市本地儿童,而且低于留守儿童。特别是,城市落户门槛越高,城市教育资源越丰富,流动儿童受教育水平反而越低,说明大城市教育资源供给缺乏包容性,流动儿童在大城市上学困难。因此,在现有制度约束下,流动人口陷入了自身高工资和子女低人力资本的两难困境。

data.abstract: Working memory (WM) is a core ability in human cognition, playing a crucial function in various tasks from perception, attention, to decision making. Although psychological and neural mechanism for WM has been widely studied, how multiple items as well as their relationship are retained and consolidated in WM remain elusive. Motivated by my lab 's previous works revealing the dynamic nature of visual attention, we hypothesize that the temporal dynamics, presumably at hundred-millisecond level, would be an appropriate time scale for multi-item storing and manipulation in WM. In this talk, I will present some experimental evidence supporting this idea. Moreover, we have developed an "dynamic perturbation" approach to manipulate multi-item WM, and a neural network incorporating short-term neural plasticity further verifies our findings. Taken together, multiple items are stored in the neutral network not in a static way but are dynamically refreshed and replayed via short-term neural plasticity at a fine temporal scale.

data.abstract: Contagious equilibria render money inessential among patient agents in some monetary models with trade in pairs. Using the Lagos-Wright model as the background, I show that money is essential because of its existence. Through a commodity-money refinement and a forward-induction refinement, I deliver that money undercuts the threatening role of collective punishment in contagious equilibria.

data.abstract: 摘要: 人脑作为目前唯一能够实现通用智能的实例,对于新型人工智能系统的设计有重要的借鉴和启示。但是由于脑本身结构、活动和功能的复杂性,以及实验技术的制约,目前对脑实现高级智能的机理尚未完全了解。在本报告中,我们将讨论在神经科学能够提供有关脑的重要信息,但这些信息尚不完备的条件下,可以从哪些层次和方面开展类脑计算的研究,并结合神经网络的临界状态,前额叶对于情境信息的灵活处理等类脑计算的实例进行探讨。

data.abstract: Using the county-level data in the newly-liberated areas , we investigate the effects of land reform in 1950s on the building of state capacity in China. We find that by confiscating landlords' land and clans' public land, as well as redistributing them to poor peasants, the reform increased the state's fiscal capacity and improved the presence of the state's agencies in the society. Furthermore, by increasing the fiscal capacity, the land reform promoted the industrialization when centralized economy prevailed, while it had no effect on industrialization during the economic decentralization. 源起2006年Science发表的关于深度置信网络研究的一篇论文,从连结主义观点出发的人工智能再度走进学界和业界关注的焦点,近十年的迅猛发展表明神经网络正深刻的改变着产业结构,也深刻的改变着科学研究的模式。本报告将勾勒人工智能,特别是深度学习研究的历史以及发展;并从理论物理的视角去看它面临的巨大挑战。虽然深度学习取得的巨大成就不可置疑,但是它作为黑箱工具,缺少理论解释,却成为它走向通用人工智能的障碍。本报告也将讲述这一挑战与脑科学之间的联系。

data.abstract: 语言、文化、身份和公民是密切相关的术语,其中"语言"和"公民"的概念始终与政治思想中的国籍概念联系在一起。因此,它们已被纳入国家语言和教育政策。语言政策,作为国家关于语言的"决策",在一些研究者看来,它可以被视为语言文化,它是思想、价值观、信仰、态度、偏见、神话、宗教约束以及说话者在处理语言时带来的所有其他文化负担的总和。语言文化与语言的传播有关,并且也与"文化的素养价值观念和文本的神圣性观念"有关。其他研究人员也有使用"语言意识形态"一词来强调特定的政策规划。本章将在参照中国的实际情况下,讨论语言和公民是如何通过国家语言政策相互联系的,以及每种语言政策作为一种特殊的语言文化概念如何在国家认同建设中扮演一个重要的角色,并构成公民教育的主要部分。

data.abstract: This paper develops a computationally tractable multi-period consumption and portfolio choice model for retired couples with dependent mortality rates. This new model enables us to unveil the significant role of mortality correlation in shaping a household's optimal post-retirement saving, investing and spending. Compared to independent couples, dependent couples optimally purchase less joint annuities but more single annuities and have higher total annuity holdings. The higher annuity holdings make dependent couples favor risky assets more than bonds. They also enable dependent couples to enjoy higher joint-life consumption. If dependent couples ignore the mortality dependence, the total demand for annuities will be substantially lower than the optimal level, leading to a lower overall utility. Using the optimal level suggested by our model as a benchmark, we show that the prevalence of ignorance and indifference about mortality dependency observed in reality is one important factor that explains the annuity puzzle. Our comparison also uncovers the value-added mechanism of joint annuities: joint annuities improve welfare by smoothing the trajectory of consumption per household member. data.abstract: 现代旅游业自兴起就带有浓厚的资本主义色彩，是资本主义经济体系重要的国际组成部分。大众旅游的发展是以旅游资源的商品化和对旅游劳工阶层的剥削为基础的。80年代以来西方大企业通过并购不断形成对旅游业的私有化，但是游客追求“新鲜”的诉求又不断塑造新的旅游地和产品，打破大企业对旅游的垄断。旅游的扶贫效果十分有限，旅游业发展难以改变既有的社会权力结构。基于批判的视角，旅游研究不是要为旅游产业服务，而是要致力于深刻理解旅游发展中资本主义特征，并试图改善旅游劳工的生计水平。

data.abstract: 统计学并不同与数学。对于心理学专业的学生来说,专业的数据科学知识,能够更好地应用于硕博士所面向的科研工作。我们需要摒弃陈旧的被灌输的概念,对自己的数据知识进行洗脑,掌握如今的数据科学:一门研究收集、分析、展示和解释数据的科学。然而出于对统计学基本概念的错误理解,我们在实际的数据分析工作中,常常会存在一些误区。通过回顾数理统计的知识和历史,进一步理解和矫正统计思维中的误区,会让我们更准确的理解数据科学方法,促进我们的研究。

data.abstract: Since the 1990s, there has been much discussion about how concepts are learned and processed. Many researchers believe that the experienced bodily states (i.e., embodied experiences) should be an important factor that affects concepts' learning and use, and metaphorical mappings between abstract concepts, such as TIME and POWER, and concrete concepts, such as SPATIAL ORIENTATION, STRUCTURED EXPERIENCEs, etc., suggest the abstract-concrete concepts' connections. In most of the recent literature, we can find common elements (e.g., concrete concepts) shared by different abstract-concrete metaphorical expressions. Therefore, we assumed that mappings might also be found between two abstract concepts that share common elements, though they have no symbolic connections. In the present studies, findings suggest that mapping between concepts was affected by common elements. We propose a dynamic model in which mappings between concepts are influenced by common elements, including symbolic or embodied information. What kind of elements (linguistic or embodied) can be used would depend on how difficult it is for a concept to be learned or accessed.

data.abstract: Since neural resources are severely limited, efﬁciently processing visual information requires selecting only a very small fraction of the multitude of information available to the visual system at any one instant in time. Attentional selection is the main mechanism that controls this selection process. In this talk, I will discuss my two studies examining the neural mechanisms of attentional selection: the saliency map and feature binding. First, the bottom-up contribution to the allocation of exogenous attention is a saliency map, whose neural substrate is hard to identify because of possible contamination by top-down signals. I will present how my first work obviates this possibility and suggests the bottom-up saliency map is created in V1. Second, I will show a color-motion misbinding developed by Wu et al. (Nature 2004), and my recent work using this illusion that provides strong and direct evidence for active feature binding in early visual cortex and for a critical role of reentrant connections from specialized intermediate areas to early visual cortex in this process. Finally, I will discuss how human early visual cortex plays an important role in the saliency map and feature binding, challenging the dominant view that the bottom-up control of attention is generated in frontoparietal networks.

data.abstract: Monetary reminders have been shown to refrain people from affiliating with others. We proposed such an effect can be reserved when others are instrumental to people's goal pursuit. Four experiments converged to support our proposition. We found that thinking about money increases people's focus on the instrumentality aspects of others (Experiment 1). More importantly, in a goal pursuit context, monetary reminders increase people's tendency to approach others who are instrumental for achieving their goals (Experiments 2). The effect of money prime on approaching others was removed when people are highly competent in achieving the goal themselves (Experiment 3), and when the goal is ambiguous (Experiment 4). These effects were fully mediated by the perceived instrumentality of others (Experiments 2-4). Our findings suggest that thinking about money leads to an instrumentality orientation in social interaction, which changes how people view relationships and how they interact with others.

data.abstract: 认知控制的动态变化往往采用比例一致效应进行研究,对于这一效应的解释主要有注意调节假说和可能性学习假说。后者暗示了一个重要的理论问题:在习得新的刺激-反应联结后,认知控制系统将如何运行。我们采用Hedge 和Marsh任务,结合比例一致效应探讨这一问题。研究发现正的和反转的Simon效应的反转模式,表明了被试用习得的刺激-反应联结来预期反应,脑成像的结果确认了这一模式,显示了习得的刺激-反应联结与任务定义的刺激-反应联结引起的冲突激活了额顶联结区。

Bethany C. Bray 博士,Ph.D., 于2000年在密歇根大学就读数学与应用统计本科,随后在宾州州立大学就读应用统计与人类发展、家庭研究方向的硕博学位。曾任弗吉尼亚理工大学心理学助理教授,现任美国宾州州立大学方法研究中心研究员。主要从事潜在类别分析(latent class analysis),潜在转变分析(latent transition analysis),因果推断模型(casual inference)、变系数模型(time varying effect model)等统计方法研究,以及吸烟、酗酒、药物滥用、赌博等预防干预领域的研究,至今在Structural Equation Modeling: A Multidisciplinary Journal,Prevention Science等学术期刊发表文章20余篇。 工作坊内容简介主题一: Introduction to Latent Class and Latent Profile Analysis 摘要: The goal of this workshop is to help participants gain the theoretical background and applied skills to be able to address interesting research questions using latent class and latent profile analysis. By the end of the workshop, participants will have examined preliminary latent class and latent profile models provided by the instructor. Participants will become familiar with many of the latent class analysis concepts covered in the recent book co-authored by Drs. Linda Collins and Stephanie Lanza and published by Wiley, Latent Class and Latent Transition Analysis: With Applications in the Social, Behavioral, and Health Sciences. Participants will also become familiar with analogous latent profile analysis concepts. Workshop time will be spent in lecture, software demonstrations, exercises, and iscussion. At the workshop, participants will be provided with an electronic copy of all lecture notes, select exercises and output, and suggested reading lists for future reference. The prerequisite for this workshop is graduate-level statistics training for the behavioral or health sciences up through linear regression.

data.abstract: 积极心理治疗技术创建于 1968 年的德国,创始人是佩塞施基安博士( Prof.Nossrat Peseschkian )。在本次沙龙中,将介绍该技术的缘起,以及相关的基本理念。

In this talk, I will present four studies using the paradigms of reversed Simon effect performed recently in our lab. Two functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) studies investigated neural correlates of learning and rule modulated cognitive control, respectively. The results suggest that dissociable mechanisms contribute to the effects of learning and rule on cognitive control. The learning effect might be mediated through the right frontopolar cortex, but the rule effect was represented by functional coupling between the medial prefrontal cortex and parieto-premotor areas and lateral prefrontal cortex. In addition, the other two (behavioral) studies further examined relationships between the effects of learning, rule and conflict context on cognitive control. The results suggest that conflict context plays a dominant role in modulating the Simon effect compared to the other two factors. The implications of the results for cognitive control will be discussed.
自然阅读时对信息的处理并非始于中央凹的直接注视，而是从副中央凹的预视状态就开始。对预视效应进行研究，有助于从极早期的时间窗了解阅读理解中不同层次和不同维度信息处理的程度和机制。在本次沙龙中，我首先介绍如何通过眼动技术探讨阅读理解中的预视加工，并介绍我们近年所做的一些相关研究，目的是探讨在中文阅读中，高层的语义信息是否可以通过预视而得以加工以及语境限制性对这一过程的影响。
